exceptions.decision: Defer the existing Prisma 6 CLI/config advisory chain for this UI-only release
constraints: Prisma CLI and configuration loading run only on repository-controlled deployment inputs
Untrusted HTTP requests cannot supply Prisma configuration or migration code
This release changes no dependencies, database schema or migration files
exceptions.followUp: Validate clinic-core compatibility with Prisma 7, then upgrade the Prisma CLI/config dependency chain in a separate release before expiry
